name: Weeknight Chicken Tacos
instructions:
Toss the chicken with chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and a big pinch of salt.
Cook in a hot skillet 5–6 minutes per side until cooked through. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
In the same pan, cook the bell pepper 3–4 minutes until just soft.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with chicken, peppers, cabbage, and sour cream. Top with cilantro and a squeeze of lime.
notes: Thighs stay juicier than breasts here.

name: Brown Butter Banana Bread
instructions:
Heat oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan.
Melt the butter in a small pan and cook until it smells nutty and turns golden brown. Let cool slightly.
Mash the bananas in a bowl. Stir in the brown butter, sugar, egg, and vanilla.
Stir in the baking soda and salt, then fold in the flour until just combined.
Bake 55–65 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
notes: Freezes well sliced — toast straight from frozen.

name: Overnight Oats
instructions:
Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, and maple syrup together in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Top with berries in the morning.
notes: Make five jars on Sunday for the whole work week.

name: Roasted Tomato Soup
instructions:
Heat oven to 425°F.
Spread the tomatoes, bell pepper, onion, and garlic on a sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Roast 35–40 minutes until soft and charred at the edges.
Transfer to a pot with the broth and blend until smooth.
Stir in the cream, warm through, and top with basil.
